note: update_helper_checklist is a submodule of update_helper that integrates with checklistapi. It registers a checklist 'update_helper_checklist' at /admin/config/development/update-helper (state storage) whose items come from scanning every enabled module dir for a file named updates_checklist.yml. Per-hook status is stored in the content entity update_helper_checklist_update. The service update_helper_checklist.update_checklist (Drupal\update_helper_checklist\UpdateChecklist) exposes markAllUpdates/markUpdatesSuccessful/markUpdatesFailed/getUpdateVersions. It auto-marks items via the update_helper.configuration.update event and extends 'drush generate configuration-update' via COMMAND_GCU_* events; a 'Pending updates' toolbar item shows while the checklist is <100% (permission: view update_helper_checklist checklistapi checklist). It has NO config of its own, so medium cases introspect the live container (service class + entity type), verified with drush php:eval. Hard cases have the agent write correct code/YAML into deletable scratch files under web/sites/default/ (update_helper_checklist_file.eval.yml, update_helper_checklist_mark.eval.php) which verify greps and reset deletes -- no cache rebuild (this shared site's 'drush cr' fatals in an unrelated canvas/ui_patterns collision). Facts grounded in update_helper_checklist.module, .install, src/UpdateChecklist.php, src/Entity/Update.php and update_helper_checklist.services.yml.

evals.prompt: With the Drupal update_helper_checklist module, where do the checklist items come from, and at what admin path is the checklist shown?
evals.expected_output: Items are gathered by scanning every enabled module's directory for a file named updates_checklist.yml. The checklist is shown at /admin/config/development/update-helper (checklist id update_helper_checklist, state storage).

evals.prompt: In code, how do I mark a module's configuration updates as complete using update_helper_checklist? Which service and method?
evals.expected_output: Use the update_helper_checklist.update_checklist service (Drupal\update_helper_checklist\UpdateChecklist). Call markUpdatesSuccessful(['mymodule' => ['mymodule_update_9001']]) (or markUpdatesFailed(), or markAllUpdates() to mark everything).

evals.prompt: What does an updates_checklist.yml file for the Drupal update_helper_checklist module look like? How are versions and individual update hooks represented?
evals.expected_output: It is YAML grouped by version key (e.g. v2.1.0) with a '#title' and '#description', and under each version one entry per update-hook name (e.g. mymodule_update_9001) with '#title', '#description', and optional '#description_successful' / '#description_failed'.

evals.prompt: On this running Drupal site, update_helper_checklist is enabled. Which service marks configuration updates complete for its checklist, and what class does it resolve to? Inspect the live container.
evals.expected_output: Service id update_helper_checklist.update_checklist, class Drupal\update_helper_checklist\UpdateChecklist. Discoverable with: drush php:eval "echo get_class(\Drupal::service('update_helper_checklist.update_checklist'));".

evals.prompt: update_helper_checklist tracks whether each update hook ran successfully. On this live site, inspect the entity-type definitions and tell me the machine id of the entity type it uses to store that per-hook status.
evals.expected_output: The content entity type update_helper_checklist_update (Drupal\update_helper_checklist\Entity\Update). Discoverable with: drush php:eval "var_export(array_key_exists('update_helper_checklist_update', \Drupal::entityTypeManager()->getDefinitions()));".

evals.prompt: Author an updates_checklist.yml for a module release using the update_helper_checklist format. Without touching real module code on this shared site, write it into the scratch file web/sites/default/update_helper_checklist_file.eval.yml (create it). It must have a version group with a '#title' and at least one update-hook entry (a key like mymodule_update_9001) that also has a '#title'.
evals.expected_output: YAML with a version key (e.g. v2.1.0) holding '#title' and, nested under it, an update-hook key (e.g. mymodule_update_9001) with its own '#title'.

evals.prompt: Write PHP that marks a module's update hooks as successfully completed in the update_helper_checklist checklist. Without touching real module code, write it into the scratch file web/sites/default/update_helper_checklist_mark.eval.php (create it). It must call the update_helper_checklist.update_checklist service's markUpdatesSuccessful() method with a module => [update hooks] map.
